cover_legend.value: Data mapping for M1 on the annealing / heat-treatment furnace, same method as the tube-mill and draw-bench books. Sits between the tube mill and drawing on the CEW/CDW route.

Furnace is SCADA-driven and the easiest connect on the line: RHF-03/04 (Siemens S7-300) and RHF-05 (ET200SP, OPC UA) already run on a Siemens SCADA that collects zone temperatures. Zone temps + line speed are AUTO.
Furnace Production Report (ANN-FT-01) + N2 PSA Gas Plant log + EXO Gas Plant log. Heat-treat recipe (temp/speed) comes from WI charts ANN-02/03/04.
Protective gas: N2-PSA (feeds RHF-04/05) or EXO (feeds RHF-03). Gas-plant params are logged hourly; AUTO if the gas plant PLC is tapped, else a manual log.
Line speed +/- 2 m/hr; soaking-zone temperature +/- 10 C. Batch entry gap: 300 mm min between lots, 6000 mm between batches. Reject/quarantine reaction plan, no rework.

Goodluck India Limited . Sikandrabad . Surface Treatment Plant (degrease / pickle / phosphate / lube for draw) . v1.0

cover_legend.value: Data mapping for M1 on the STP (Surface Treatment Plant), same method as the other books. Sits between annealing and drawing; prepares the tube surface for cold draw.
Tube mill -> Annealing -> STP (this) -> Draw bench. Re-entered between draw passes to re-lubricate.
Degrease, pickle (HCl), activate, phosphate, neutralize, lubricate, dry. The phosphate coat carries draw lubrication only; it is NOT a final-product criterion.
STP is SCADA / auto: overhead crane in auto mode, dip time and bath temperature preset. Controller is Siemens ET200S (IM151) + TP700 Comfort HMI (OPC UA capable). Bath temps + dip times are AUTO.
AUTO: bath temperatures, dip times, crane/wagon state (from ET200S / TP700). MANUAL: bath analysis (lab titration - TA/FA/pH/acid%), phosphate coating weight, bath-change history.
STP Production cum Process Monitoring (STP-FT-01A) + Bath Process History Card (STP-FT-04B) + Phosphate Coating Weight (STP-FT-06).

cover_legend.value: Data mapping for M1 on the draw bench and swaging stages, same method as the tube-mill book: every shop-floor sheet field mapped to its digital field, capture class, source and target.

The draw bench is a batch, multi-machine, operator-recorded (L1) process. There is no continuous hourly parameter sheet and no auto downtime sheet. Draw speed is fixed by motor rpm, not logged. Dimensions are measured by hand.

Machine check sheet (start of shift), Production + 1st-off/last-off inspection report, Die and plug history card, Swaging production report. Plus reference tables A (special controls), B (paint colour), C (bench capability).
Drawing is a repeated cycle: Furnace, STP, Swage, Draw bench, Centreless straighten, repeated for 1st / 2nd / 3rd draw to final size. Capture keys on lot + work order + draw pass.
Draw-bench PLCs (DB-01..07) give production count, cycle time, pulling load and motor rpm only. Quality (OD/ID/THK/surface) stays MANUAL measurement. Connect DB-05/06/07 first (Ethernet-native).

Formats folder received. The production report is GLI-FT-PRD-DRW-01 (DB-FT-01, R6) with FROM/TO dims and accepted/rejected/drawn-meter; die history is DRW-03; a die & plug issue slip DRW-08 and swaging reports SWG-FT-01/02 are now in hand. Only the machine check sheet DRAW-07 is still missing.
